components.name: RootLayout
components.purpose: Wraps every page with the global shell, fonts, session provider and the Navbar.

components.name: Navbar
props: user: { name: string; email: string } | null
components.purpose: Provides primary navigation across dashboard, clients, invoices, expenses, forecast, what-if scenarios and profile.

components.name: FinancialDashboardPage
components.purpose: Shows the financial overview, health score and actionable recommendations.

components.name: LoginPage
components.purpose: Lets users sign in with email and password.

components.name: SignUpPage
components.purpose: Lets new freelancers, designers, creators and consultants create an account.

components.name: ForgotPasswordPage
components.purpose: Requests a password reset link to be sent by email.

components.name: ResetPasswordPage
components.purpose: Lets the user set a new password from the emailed reset link.

components.name: ProfilePage
components.purpose: Lets the user update name, email and password, and sign out.

components.name: ClientsPage
components.purpose: Lists the user's clients with links to add or open each one.

components.name: ClientDetailPage
components.purpose: Shows and edits one client's details along with their related invoices.

components.name: NewClientPage
components.purpose: Provides the form to add a new client.

components.name: InvoicesPage
components.purpose: Lists invoices and highlights which payments are pending.

components.name: InvoiceDetailPage
components.purpose: Shows one invoice and lets the user track and update its payment status.

components.name: NewInvoicePage
components.purpose: Creates a new invoice for a selected client.

components.name: ExpensesPage
components.purpose: Lists business expenses and tracks spending.

components.name: ExpenseDetailPage
components.purpose: Shows and edits a single expense.

components.name: CashFlowForecastPage
components.purpose: Projects future cash flow from invoices, pending payments and expenses.

components.name: WhatIfScenariosPage
components.purpose: Simulates payment scenarios and shows their effect on projected cash flow.

boundaries: Public auth routes (/login, /signup, /forgot-password, /reset-password) are separate from the authenticated app routes
Pages fetch and mutate data through server actions; components stay presentational
Financial calculations (forecast, health score, what-if) live in a server-side domain module, not in page components
Only Navbar and RootLayout are shared chrome; all other UI is owned by its declared page

flows.name: sign-up-and-onboard
flows.summary: A new freelancer, designer, creator or consultant creates an account and lands on the financial dashboard.

flows.name: sign-in-and-recover-password
flows.summary: A returning user signs in, or requests a reset link and sets a new password from the emailed link.

flows.name: add-client-and-invoice
flows.summary: The user adds a client, then creates an invoice for that client and tracks its payment status.

flows.name: record-business-expense
flows.summary: The user records a business expense and reviews it in the expenses list and detail view.

flows.name: review-dashboard-and-recommendations
flows.summary: The user reviews the financial health score and acts on the recommendations shown on the dashboard.

flows.name: forecast-cash-flow
flows.summary: The user projects future cash flow from invoices, pending payments and expenses.

flows.name: simulate-what-if-payments
flows.summary: The user simulates payment scenarios and compares their effect on projected cash flow.
